faq.q: Will my website show on Google?
faq.a: Yes — every site is built SEO-ready with clean structure, speed optimisation and Google Search Console setup. Ranking for competitive terms takes ongoing SEO, which we also offer.

faq.q: Who owns the website, domain, and accounts?
faq.a: You do. Domain, website files, app source code and store accounts belong to you once the project is paid for.

faq.q: What about domain and hosting? Do I have to pay you?
faq.a: You buy your own domain and hosting directly under your own name so you maintain 100% control forever. Yes, we will help you buy, guide you through every step, and set up everything end-to-end for you.

faq.q: Can I see and approve the design before finalizing?
faq.a: Design you approve: See your homepage or app screens first. Enjoy unlimited changes for a week at the design stage so you get exactly what you envision.

faq.q: Do you provide support after the website is launched?
faq.a: We offer support for changes, updates and fixes after launch — just call or WhatsApp the team anytime.

faq.q: Can I edit my contact details, phone, and add new projects later?
faq.a: Yes! We provide an integrated, lightweight Studio Admin Portal right in your browser where you can update phone numbers, WhatsApp, emails, pricing, and showcase new work with zero coding required.
